e.title: **APRA 执法（Enforcement）页**（`apra.gov.au/enforcement`）：⭐ 站点标题逐字为「**Enforcement | APRA**」——⭐ 页内四个子入口逐字为「**Disqualification Register**」「**Enforceable undertakings**」「**Infringement notices**」「**Infringement Notice Guidelines**」；⭐ 页面逐字写明执法立场「**APRA also has a broad range of formal enforcement powers that it can use to deliver its mandate.**」与「**APRA will be prepared to use enforcement to prevent and address serious prudential risks and to hold entities and individuals to account.**」；⭐ 并记录执法方针的发布日「**On 16 April 2019, APRA released its Enforcement Approach (the Approach).**」——**本条与第 385 轮的 [[apra-registers]]「谁在册」配成一套：一个给准入，一个给处分。**
e.summary: **澳大利亚审慎监管局（APRA）的执法（Enforcement）公开面**：本条补的是**「谁被处分」这一层**，与第 385 轮的 [[apra-registers]]（谁在册）严格配对。页面把执法公开分成四个子入口，逐字为 **Disqualification Register**（取消任职资格登记册）、**Enforceable undertakings**（可强制执行承诺）、**Infringement notices**（侵权通知）、**Infringement Notice Guidelines**（侵权通知指引）；正文逐字给出执法立场与方针来源：**APRA also has a broad range of formal enforcement powers that it can use to deliver its mandate.** 与 **On 16 April 2019, APRA released its Enforcement Approach**，并说明该方针**后来增补了「何时、如何公开执法行动」的原则**。本次实测 **HTTP 200 / 327,865 字节**，清洗后可见正文 **18,563 字符**。
e.body:
**APRA（Australian Prudential Regulation Authority，澳大利亚审慎监管局）的 Enforcement 页**（`apra.gov.au/enforcement`）是**执法与处分的公开面**。⭐ 本条与**第 385 轮收录的 [[apra-registers]]**（谁在册）**严格配对**：**一个回答「谁被允许经营」，一个回答「谁被处分、被取消资格」**——⭐ 这两层合起来，才构成**一个法域的准入与退出**。**对做机构风险或雇主尽调的人，两个页面要一起看**。
**页内四个子入口逐字实测**：① **Disqualification Register**（**取消任职资格登记册**）；② **Enforceable undertakings**（**可强制执行承诺**）；③ **Infringement notices**（**侵权通知**）；④ **Infringement Notice Guidelines**（**侵权通知指引**）。⭐ 这四项的形态差别值得注意：**登记册**（人名与资格）、**承诺**（机构与监管达成的可执行约定）、**通知**（较轻的违法处理）与**指引**（规则本身）——**同一页同时提供「结果」「协议」「处分的规则」三类信息**，做制度比较时可以按这三类去对别国。
**执法立场逐字**（本条照抄）：⭐「**APRA also has a broad range of formal enforcement powers that it can use to deliver its mandate.**」；⭐「**This means that APRA will be prepared to use enforcement to prevent and address serious prudential risks and to hold entities and individuals to account.**」——即**执法的两个目的是「预防与处置严重审慎风险」与「让机构和个人承担责任」**；⭐ 方针来源逐字：「**APRA’s Enforcement Approach On 16 April 2019, APRA released its Enforcement Approach (the Approach).**」，并说明「**The Approach sets out how APRA will use its enforcement powers to prevent and address serious prudential risks, and to hold entities and individuals to account.**」，以及该方针「**has been endorsed by the APRA Board, implements recommendation two of the Final Report of the Enforcement Strategy Review.**」。
**方针后来被增补过一处，这一点值得单独记**：页面逐字写它「**updated to include principles that APRA will take into account when considering when and how to publicise its enforcement actions, and guidance on APRA’s approach to enforcement for data submissions.**」——⭐ 即**「何时公开、如何公开执法行动」本身被写成了原则**，另外还有**针对数据报送的执法取向**。⚠️ **该增补的具体时间与版本本次未取**（页面只给了方针 PDF 链接）。
**与第 385 轮的接口**：[[apra-registers]] 的「其他登记册」区里有一条 **List of disqualified individuals**，描述逐字为 **A list of individuals who have been have been disqualified from roles in APRA-regulated entities.**；本页的 **Disqualification Register** 是**同一件事的另一个入口**——⭐ 也就是说，**「取消资格」在 APRA 的公开面上有两个可达点**（名单页与执法页），⚠️ **两者是否为同一份数据本次未验证**。
**页面体量的构成也值得一提**：18,563 字符的可见正文里，**enforcement 命中 21 次、disqualif 10 次、undertaking 5 次**，⭐ 即**这一页同时承担「方针说明」与「结果入口」两种功能**——**方针是散文式说明，结果是四个子入口**（页面给出「**APRA’s Enforcement Approach PDF**」链接，⚠️ **该 PDF 未下载**）。
**一个可以带去问别国监管机关的问题**：⭐「**你们有没有把「何时、如何公开执法行动」写成原则？**」——**APRA 有**（见上文增补句），而本轮另外三条**未观察到同类表述**（⚠️ **只能说「本次未观察到」，不能说「没有」**）。**把这个差异带去对照香港、内地、新加坡的做法，就是一个可写进论文的比较维度**。
**对 RIAA 学生的用法**：① 做**澳洲机构尽调**时，**先在 [[apra-registers]] 确认它在册，再在本页看它有没有承诺书或侵权通知**；② 做**跨境执法公开度比较**时，把本页与 [[mas-enforcement]]（新加坡，带执法计数）、[[central-bank-ireland-enforcement]]（爱尔兰，公开罚款流向）、[[japan-fsa-administrative-actions]]（日本，含处分事例集）并读——**四种「怎么把处分讲给公众听」的做法**；③ 研究**监管公信力**的，**「公开执法行动的原则」被写进方针**这一条本身就是可引用的制度设计。
**窗口状况（2026-10-01）**：`https://www.apra.gov.au/enforcement` 实测 **HTTP 200 / 327,865 字节**，站点标题逐字「**Enforcement | APRA**」，清洗后可见正文 **18,563 字符**（enforcement 21 次、disqualif 10 次、undertaking 5 次命中）。⚠️ **未核实项**：① **四个子入口各自的正文与条目数未取**（只取本页）；② **Enforcement Approach 的 PDF 未下载**（页面给出「**APRA’s Enforcement Approach PDF**」链接）；③ **「公开执法行动原则」的增补时间与版本**未取；④ **本页的 Disqualification Register 与 [[apra-registers]] 的 disqualified individuals 名单是否为同一数据**未验证；⑤ **侵权通知的金额与件数**未取。
e.verified_note: **窗口状况（2026-10-01）**：`https://www.apra.gov.au/enforcement` 返回 **HTTP 200 / 327,865 字节**，站点标题逐字「**Enforcement | APRA**」；清洗脚本（去 script/style/标签后折叠空白）得到**可见正文 18,563 字符**（enforcement 21 次、disqualif 10 次、undertaking 5 次）；同日实测，服务器 `date:` 头与本机 **2026-10-01** 一致。⚠️ **未核实**：① **四个子入口（Disqualification Register／Enforceable undertakings／Infringement notices／Infringement Notice Guidelines）各自的正文与条目数未取**——本条目**只写本页列出的入口名与页内逐字表述**；② **Enforcement Approach 的 PDF 未下载**；③ **「何时、如何公开执法行动」原则的增补时间与版本**未取；④ **本页 Disqualification Register 与 [[apra-registers]] 的 disqualified individuals 名单是否同一份数据未验证**；⑤ **侵权通知的金额、件数**未取。⚠️ 页内英文引文一律**逐字照抄**（含 APRA’s 等所有格，撇号按 **U+2019** 转写）。

e.summary_hk: **澳洲審慎監管局（APRA）嘅執法（Enforcement）公開面**：本條補嘅係**「邊個被處分」呢一層**，同第 385 輪嘅 [[apra-registers]]（邊個在冊）嚴格配對。頁面將執法公開分成四個子入口，逐字為 **Disqualification Register**（取消任職資格登記冊）、**Enforceable undertakings**（可強制執行承諾）、**Infringement notices**（侵權通知）、**Infringement Notice Guidelines**（侵權通知指引）；正文逐字給出執法立場同方針來源：**On 16 April 2019, APRA released its Enforcement Approach**，並說明該方針**後來增補咗「何時、如何公開執法行動」嘅原則**。本次實測 **HTTP 200 / 327,865 字節**，清洗後可見正文 **18,563 字符**。
e.body_en:
**APRA’s Enforcement page** at `apra.gov.au/enforcement` is **the public surface for enforcement and sanction**. ⭐ It pairs strictly with **[[apra-registers]], collected in Round 385** (who is licensed): **one answers who may operate, the other answers who has been sanctioned or disqualified** — together they describe **admission to and exit from a jurisdiction**, and **anyone doing institutional risk work or employer due diligence should read both**.
**The four sub-entries, measured verbatim**: (1) **Disqualification Register**; (2) **Enforceable undertakings**; (3) **Infringement notices**; (4) **Infringement Notice Guidelines**. ⭐ The difference in form matters: a **register** (names and status), an **undertaking** (an enforceable agreement with the regulator), a **notice** (a lighter finding) and **guidelines** (the rule itself) — **one page thus offers outcomes, agreements and the rules for sanctioning at once**, which is a useful three-way frame when comparing jurisdictions.
**The enforcement stance, verbatim**: ⭐ **APRA also has a broad range of formal enforcement powers that it can use to deliver its mandate.**; ⭐ **This means that APRA will be prepared to use enforcement to prevent and address serious prudential risks and to hold entities and individuals to account.** ⭐ **The source of the approach, verbatim**: **APRA’s Enforcement Approach On 16 April 2019, APRA released its Enforcement Approach (the Approach).**, which **sets out how APRA will use its enforcement powers to prevent and address serious prudential risks, and to hold entities and individuals to account.** and which **has been endorsed by the APRA Board, implements recommendation two of the Final Report of the Enforcement Strategy Review.**
**One later addition deserves separate note**: the page says the approach was **updated to include principles that APRA will take into account when considering when and how to publicise its enforcement actions, and guidance on APRA’s approach to enforcement for data submissions.** ⭐ That is, **when and how enforcement actions are publicised is itself written down as a principle**, alongside guidance on **enforcement for data submissions**. ⚠️ **The date and version of that update were not retrieved** (the page only links the approach PDF).
**The interface with Round 385**: [[apra-registers]] carries a **List of disqualified individuals** described verbatim as **A list of individuals who have been have been disqualified from roles in APRA-regulated entities.**, while this page carries the **Disqualification Register**. ⭐ So **disqualification has two reachable entry points on APRA’s public surface**, and ⚠️ **whether they are the same dataset was not verified**.
**How an RIAA student can use it.** (1) For **Australian institution due diligence**, first confirm the entity is on [[apra-registers]], then look here for an undertaking or an infringement notice. (2) For **cross-border comparison of enforcement transparency**, read it with [[mas-enforcement]] (Singapore, with enforcement counts), [[central-bank-ireland-enforcement]] (Ireland, which discloses where fines go) and [[japan-fsa-administrative-actions]] (Japan, which includes a casebook) — **four ways of explaining sanction to the public**. (3) For **regulatory credibility**, the fact that **the principles for publicising enforcement are written into the approach** is itself a citable design choice.
**Window status (2026-10-01)**: `https://www.apra.gov.au/enforcement` returned **HTTP 200 / 327,865 bytes**, site title verbatim **Enforcement | APRA**, with **18,563 visible characters** after cleaning (21 hits of enforcement, 10 of disqualif, 5 of undertaking). ⚠️ **Not verified**: (1) the **body and row counts of the four sub-entries**; (2) the **Enforcement Approach PDF** (not downloaded); (3) **when the publicity principles were added**; (4) whether the **Disqualification Register here and the disqualified individuals list on [[apra-registers]] are the same data**; (5) **amounts and counts of infringement notices**.
e.body_hk:
**APRA（澳洲審慎監管局）嘅 Enforcement 頁**（`apra.gov.au/enforcement`）係**執法同處分嘅公開面**。⭐ 本條同**第 385 輪收錄嘅 [[apra-registers]]**（邊個在冊）**嚴格配對**：**一個答「邊個被允許經營」，一個答「邊個被處分、被取消資格」**——⭐ 兩層合起來才構成**一個法域嘅准入同退出**。
**頁內四個子入口逐字實測**：① **Disqualification Register**（取消任職資格登記冊）；② **Enforceable undertakings**（可強制執行承諾）；③ **Infringement notices**（侵權通知）；④ **Infringement Notice Guidelines**（侵權通知指引）。⭐ 四項形態差別值得注意：**登記冊**（人名與資格）、**承諾**（機構同監管達成嘅可執行約定）、**通知**（較輕嘅違法處理）同**指引**（規則本身）——**同一頁同時提供「結果」「協議」「處分規則」三類資訊**。
**執法立場逐字**：⭐「**APRA also has a broad range of formal enforcement powers that it can use to deliver its mandate.**」；⭐「**This means that APRA will be prepared to use enforcement to prevent and address serious prudential risks and to hold entities and individuals to account.**」；⭐ 方針來源逐字「**On 16 April 2019, APRA released its Enforcement Approach (the Approach).**」，並說明該方針「**has been endorsed by the APRA Board, implements recommendation two of the Final Report of the Enforcement Strategy Review.**」。
**方針後來增補過一處**：頁面逐字寫佢「**updated to include principles that APRA will take into account when considering when and how to publicise its enforcement actions, and guidance on APRA’s approach to enforcement for data submissions.**」——⭐ 即**「何時公開、如何公開執法行動」本身被寫成原則**。⚠️ **該增補嘅具體時間同版本本次未取**。
**同第 385 輪嘅接口**：[[apra-registers]] 嘅「其他登記冊」區有一條 **List of disqualified individuals**；本頁嘅 **Disqualification Register** 係**同一件事嘅另一個入口**——⚠️ **兩者係否同一份數據本次未驗證**。
**對 RIAA 學生嘅用法**：① 做**澳洲機構盡調**時，**先在 [[apra-registers]] 確認在冊，再喺本頁睇有冇承諾書或侵權通知**；② 做**跨境執法公開度比較**時，同 [[mas-enforcement]]、[[central-bank-ireland-enforcement]]、[[japan-fsa-administrative-actions]] 並讀；③ 研究**監管公信力**嘅，**「公開執法行動嘅原則」被寫進方針**本身就係可引用嘅制度設計。
**窗口狀況（2026-10-01）**：`https://www.apra.gov.au/enforcement` 實測 **HTTP 200 / 327,865 字節**，站點標題逐字「**Enforcement | APRA**」，清洗後可見正文 **18,563 字符**。⚠️ **未核實項**：① **四個子入口各自正文與條數未取**；② **方針 PDF 未下載**；③ **公開原則嘅增補時間未取**；④ **本頁 Disqualification Register 同 [[apra-registers]] 名單係否同一數據未驗證**；⑤ **侵權通知金額與件數未取**。
